metadata.case_name: FAN SIU KWAN v. KAMAN FASHION COMPANY LIMITED

plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: she could return to her previous job as a sales lady or to take up some lighter jobs such as a salesgirl in retail shops, an office worker or a cashier.

injuries.description: strained injury to the soft tissues of her back
source: Dr. Lau commented in the report that the plaintiff had suffered from strained injury to the soft tissues of her back with mild prolapse of the intervertebral disc at the L5/S1 level.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of muscle, fascia or tendon of lower back

injuries.description: mild prolapse / protrusion of the intervertebral disc at the L5/S1 level
source: Dr. Lau commented in the report that the plaintiff had suffered from strained injury to the soft tissues of her back with mild prolapse of the intervertebral disc at the L5/S1 level.
The MRI revealed a protrusion of the L5/S1 disc without pressing on any nerve root and Dr Lau opined that the treatment was appropriate.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

manifestations.description: stiffness and pain on her back
numbness and tightness of the left lower limb

treatments_received: attendance at A & E Department of Princess Margaret Hospital
treatments_future: a short course of treatment when recurrence of symptoms occurs
practice some sports to recondition her spine and spinal muscles

losses.description: Pain, suffering and loss of amenity claimed as PSLA (judge used $250,000 as a reasonable assessment for the purpose of choosing forum).
Pre-trial and post-trial loss of earnings and loss of earning capacity (loss of earning capacity accepted at $100,000).
